t: You're looking at a bronze bust of Noor Inayat Khan, made by the sculptor Karen Newman. Noor Inayat Khan was a British-Indian agent in the Second World War who served in the Special Operations Executive, which carried out espionage, sabotage and reconnaissance in countries occupied by Nazi Germany. She was awarded the George Cross. The sculptor is also known for her bust of Violette Szabo, on the Albert Embankment outside Lambeth Palace.
